item.title: Hand-finished ceramic serving collection with an extra-wide presentation platter
item.variant: Speckled oat glaze · Three-piece family set

model.contextMessage: The bottle is eligible for a return in its original packaging.

options.title: Refund to your card
options.description: Return the purchase amount to the original payment method.
options.detailBody: Mastercard ending 6059 · Allow 3–5 business days after inspection.

options.title: Flexible store credit for a future collection
options.description: We add a ten-percent bonus to the value of the eligible items after the return passes inspection. You may use the balance across more than one future order.
options.detailBody: The complete balance is issued to the email address on your original order. If your household shares that address, anyone with the credit code can use it.
options.acknowledgementLabel: I have reviewed the store-credit policy and understand that the bonus and original balance cannot later be converted into a bank-card refund.

options.title: Replace this item
options.description: Reserve a different size while this return is in transit.
options.detailBody: Choose one available size. We release the replacement after the carrier scans the original.
options.acknowledgementLabel: I agree to return the original item before the replacement is released.

notes.title: Read packing, inspection, and delivery instructions
notes.body: Wrap each ceramic piece separately, fill all empty space in a sturdy carton, and keep the package away from moisture while waiting for collection. The warehouse checks each piece after it arrives; this normally takes five business days.
bullets: Include the original protective sleeves if you still have them; replacement packaging is acceptable.
If a piece was damaged when it arrived, add a handwritten note identifying that piece so the inspection team can match your earlier report.

model.totalFootnote: Credit is issued after inspection. This estimate uses the amounts shown on your original order and includes the stated bonus.
model.progressBody: We are saving your decision and preparing the return label.
model.resultBody: We sent the label and instructions to the email used for your order.
